title: Split trivializing covers over a separably closed point for arbitrary condensed coefficients
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a separably closed field (every nonconstant separable polynomial over $\Omega$ has a root), $X=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-scheme], and $\Lambda$ any commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Put $R=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on the small pro-etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and use internal $R$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. For every lisse $R$-module $L$ [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module] and every trivializing cover $\{u_i:U_i\to X\}$ equipped with isomorphisms $\tau_i:L|_{U_i}\cong(R|_{U_i})^{\oplus n_i}$ on the slice sites [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], there exist an index $i$ and a morphism $s:X\to U_i$ of this site with $u_i\circ s=1_X$. Relocalizing $\tau_i$ along $s$ yields an isomorphism of internal modules on the whole site $L\cong R^{\oplus n_i}$; under the equivalence with sectionwise module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] its component at $V$ is the component of $\tau_i$ at $(V\to X\xrightarrow{s}U_i)$. The finite rank $n_i=0$ is allowed. There is no topology, completeness or field assumption on the coefficient ring $\Lambda$.

proof.text: The residue map from Ω to its residue field is bijective: it is surjective for any local ring and injective for a field. Transport separable closedness through this ring equivalence. Fields are henselian, so Ω is strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. The existing theorem IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing.isWContractibleRing verifies the maximal-localization and component-space clauses of [det-pe-wlocal-strict-contractible], giving w-contractibility without repeating those constructions.

source.place: Tag 0982, lemma-w-local-strictly-henselian-extremally-disconnected, condition (3); elementary verification for a separably closed field

proof.text: Apply [det-pe-wcb-clopen-partition] to the given covering of the final object $X$ of its small pro-etale site. It gives a finite clopen partition of $X$ and $X$-morphisms from its pieces into covering members. Since $X$ has exactly one point, one piece is the whole open subscheme $X$; the partition cannot be empty. Its associated map is $s:X\to U_i$ with $u_i\circ s=1_X$. By [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], site morphisms are all $X$-morphisms, so this section is a morphism of the site.

source.place: Tag 098F, lemma-w-contractible-proetale-cover, implication (1) to (2), specialized to a one-point target

proof.text: Let E be the section-module equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Every site object V has its unique structural arrow c_V to the final object X. Put b_V = c_V followed by s. Evaluate tau_i on (V,b_V) to obtain an isomorphism of the section modules E(L)(V) and E(R^{n_i})(V); this uses the unchanged section rings in localization [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For f:V to Vprime, uniqueness gives f followed by b_Vprime = b_V; tau_i naturality on that slice arrow gives the required naturality equation. PresheafOfModules.isoMk constructs the presheaf-module isomorphism, which lifts through the fully faithful sheaf forgetful functor and then through E. Functor.map_preimage gives the exact component formula; any supplied v equals c_V. The free module itself is never unfolded, so the construction applies unchanged to rank zero and arbitrary condensed coefficients.

lean.statement: theorem separablyClosed_lisse_split_trivialization (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (Λ : Profinite.CondensedRing.{u}) [IsCommMonObj Λ.X] (L : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of Ω))) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ.X (Spec (.of Ω)))) (hL : IsLisseCoefficientModule Λ.X L) (I : Type v) (U : I → (Spec (.of Ω)).ProEt) (a : ∀ i : I, U i ⟶ Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))) (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows U a ∈ Scheme.ProEt.precoverage (Spec (.of Ω)) (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω))))) (n : I → ℕ) (τ : ∀ i : I, ((sectionModuleEquivalence (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of Ω))) (condensedRingObj Λ.X (Spec (.of Ω)))).functor.obj L).over (U i) ≅ ((sectionModuleEquivalence (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of Ω))) (condensedRingObj Λ.X (Spec (.of Ω)))).functor.obj (Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj Λ.X (Spec (.of Ω))) (n i))).over (U i)) : ∃ (i : I) (s : Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω))) ⟶ U i), s ≫ a i = 𝟙 _ ∧ ∃ φ : L ≅ Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj Λ.X (Spec (.of Ω))) (n i), ∀ (V : (Spec (.of Ω)).ProEt) (v : V ⟶ Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))), (((sectionModuleEquivalence (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of Ω))) (condensedRingObj Λ.X (Spec (.of Ω)))).functor.map φ.hom).val.app (op V)).hom = ((τ i).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (v ≫ s)))).hom
